newsitem.title: UK: LME metals unmoved in late trading.
newsitem.headline: LME metals unmoved in late trading.

text.p: LME copper remained virtually unchanged in late inter-office trading on Tuesday evening.
At 1800 GMT, three months copper was indicated at $2,583/84 per tonne versus a kerb close of $2,582.
The market showed little immediate reaction to news that striking workers at Inco's Sudbury operations want to resume negotiations.
A trade union official said workers, who have been on strike since June 2, were keen to reach an agreement with the firm.
Nickel prices also ignored the news, holding around the $7,200 area where it closed.
